ShortDescription.Value: Runtime save repair, corrupted component bypass, and fallback asset deserialization mod for Cities: Skylines II.

LongDescription.Value: CS2 Save Fixer is an emergency save recovery and runtime protection mod for Cities: Skylines II. It dynamically intercepts missing prefab GUID errors during loading and runs automated ECS cleanup passes to sanitize floating-point (NaN/Infinity) coordinate corruptions.

ChangeLog.Value: Initial release of CS2 Save Fixer code mod with safe deserialization and runtime ECS sanitization.
